description: A fault flag with an OK note synthesises a note from the dbg blob. Locks in the discarded rtrim: the stored value keeps its trailing space (known issue 11).

phases.label: fl=1 with dbg markers
sql: UPDATE charge_points SET fault_note='OK' WHERE id=1

sql.query: SELECT CONCAT('[',fault_note,']') FROM meter_events WHERE id=1
sql.value: [GROUND FAULT. CONNECTOR LOCK FAULT. UNDER VOLTAGE. ]
